The '''Orixon Nebula''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]. It had formed by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] out of the [[Kashi system]], which had been destroyed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] twenty [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] earlier. By 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was situated within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and by [[3643 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had declared it off-limits. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual recovered an ancient relic from a derelict [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the Orixon Nebula.

==Description==
The Orixon Nebula was a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The Orixon Nebula had formed by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] from the remains of the [[Kashi system]],<ref name="TEA" /> which had been destroyed as a result of a sudden and inexplicable [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] explosion<ref name="RelicReprint">{{JournalCite|6|Relic (article)}}</ref> at some point by [[24,500 BBY]].<ref name="24500BBY">The [[Kashi system]] was destroyed at some point by [[24,500 BBY]] per {{KashiDestructionDate}}.</ref> By 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was situated within the borders of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and it remained so at least until the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point, a derelict [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carrying a relic from the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="Lost in the Mist">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Lost in the Mist}}</ref> of 5000 BBY<ref name="TEA" /> began drifting in the Orixon Nebula.<ref name="Lost in the Mist" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Lost in the Mist" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual affiliated with one of two conflicting factions of the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] learned of a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] being received from the vessel drifting in the nebula, which by that [[Time/Legends|time]] members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had declared off-limits. The individual subsequently sent a companion to negotiate passage into the nebula for a rescue starship. After having bartered with the Hutts for salvage rights, the companion boarded the ancient ship and discovered the relic.<ref name="Lost in the Mist" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Orixon Nebula was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" /> The nebula was later mentioned in a Diplomacy Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', although the information on that mission's outcome was eventually removed from the game.<ref name="Lost in the Mist" />
